title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 040
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute music and headphone variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Beamed musical note with two round note heads and one top bar
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a double note symbol with a connecting top beam.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the single note or circular note icons when two note heads are visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows two round note heads connected by one short top beam.

items.depicts_observation: Single musical note with one round head and a short flag at the top
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants one simple music note instead of a beamed pair.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the double note or circular note icons when only one note head should show.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot reduces the music symbol to one note head and one flagged stem.

items.depicts_observation: Round ring icon with one single note head inside the circle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a music note enclosed inside a circular ring frame.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the free standing note icons when the outer ring needs to remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot wraps the single music note inside a circular ring frame.

items.depicts_observation: Over ear headphone outline with a round headband and angled ear pads
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants over ear headphones with a rounded headband and angled pads.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the straighter headphone frame when the round headband curve matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a soft round headband ending in two angled ear pad shapes.

items.depicts_observation: Headphone outline with a tall U shaped band and straight rounded ear pads
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants headphones with a straighter U shaped band and vertical ear pads.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rounder headphone icon when the tall U band should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot straightens the headband into a taller U and makes the ear pads more vertical.
